categories.main_business_segments: The company operates through four primary business segments: (1) Industrial robots and automation application systems, including multi-joint robots, SCARA robots, and Cartesian coordinate robots; (2) Injection molding machines, auxiliary equipment and automatic feeding systems, including hydraulic and electric injection molding machines; (3) CNC machine tools, particularly five-axis linkage CNC machining centers; and (4) Intelligent energy and environmental management systems for customized engineering solutions. The company is strategically shifting focus toward product-based businesses while reducing project-based operations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed three core bottom-layer technologies: motion control systems, servo drive systems, and vision systems. Key manufacturing methods include precision machining, assembly, and integration of robotic components. The company has developed a new-generation intelligent robot control platform with 'sensing-computing-controlling' integration, featuring motion control technology that serves as the 'cerebellum and spine' for embodied AI applications. The company also manufactures core components including custom high-speed spindles, precision turntables, and power tool heads for CNC machines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves diverse manufacturing industries including 3C electronics, automotive parts, new energy (lithium battery and photovoltaic), food and beverage, medical devices, and general industrial sectors. Key customer segments include major manufacturers such as Foxconn, Luxshare Precision, Huaqin Technology, Wentai Technology, Goertek, and Longi Green Energy. The company has accumulated service relationships with over 15,000 customers across multiple industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with headquarters in Dongguan, Guangdong Province. It maintains approximately 30 domestic branch offices and a sales team of over 300 people. International operations include subsidiaries in Vietnam, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, and Hong Kong. The company has established overseas sales networks covering over 50 countries and regions, with growing presence in Southeast Asia and North America.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple supply chain positions: upstream in core component manufacturing (servo drives, motion controllers, vision systems), midstream in equipment manufacturing (robots, injection molding machines, CNC machines), and downstream in system integration and automation solutions. The company manufactures key components internally while sourcing specialized parts from suppliers, positioning itself as an integrated equipment manufacturer and solution provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus is on transitioning from project-based to product-based business models while aggressively pursuing embodied AI applications. R&D priorities include: (1) advancing motion control platforms for embodied intelligence; (2) developing collaborative and humanoid robots; (3) enhancing electric injection molding machine technology; (4) improving five-axis CNC machine capabilities for emerging industries like low-altitude aircraft and humanoid robots; and (5) integrating large language models with industrial robotics through partnerships with Huawei Cloud, Zhipu, and Alibaba Cloud.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of industrial robots, injection molding machines, CNC machine tools, and related equipment. Secondary revenue comes from system integration services and customized engineering solutions for intelligent energy and environmental management systems. The company operates on a direct sales model supplemented by domestic and international distributors and agents. Revenue recognition occurs upon customer acceptance and control transfer of products, or upon project completion for engineering services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In industrial robots, the company competes with both international leaders (ABB, KUKA, Fanuc) and domestic competitors. The company has strengthened its market position through cost advantages and localized service. In CNC machines, the company's subsidiary Evermi ranks among leading domestic manufacturers, competing with international brands like DMG Mori and Okuma. In injection molding machines, competitors include international brands (Engel, Sumitomo Demag) and domestic players (Haitian, Zhenxiong). The company emphasizes cost-effectiveness, customization, and local support as competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of 2.87 billion yuan, representing a 36.92% decline from 2023's 4.55 billion yuan, primarily due to strategic contraction of low-margin project business. The company reported a net loss of 245 million yuan in 2024 versus net income of 88 million yuan in 2023. However, product-based business revenue and gross margins increased, with gross margin reaching 34.25% excluding energy management systems. The company maintains total assets of 5.94 billion yuan and shareholder equity of 2.80 billion yuan as of December 31, 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through: (1) integrated core technology capabilities in motion control, servo drives, and vision systems enabling superior product performance; (2) deep industrial application expertise and process understanding accumulated across 15,000+ customers; (3) embodied AI integration positioning robots as 'machines that understand people' rather than simple automation; (4) cost-competitive products with localized service support; (5) comprehensive solutions spanning robots, injection molding, and CNC machines for integrated manufacturing automation; and (6) commitment to developing 'the most process-savvy intelligent robots' through customer co-development and real-world scenario validation.
